description:
Lantana is a colorful garden shrub that is very dangerous for cats. All parts of the plant are toxic, but the unripe green berries are the most concentrated. If a cat eats any part of this plant, it can lead to serious liver damage or even liver failure.

The toxins in Lantana cause the liver to stop working correctly, which can lead to yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice). Other signs of poisoning include severe vomiting, diarrhea, weakness, and trouble breathing.

Because Lantana is so toxic, you should treat any amount eaten as an emergency. Do not wait for symptoms like yellowing to show up. Contact a veterinarian or an emergency animal hospital immediately.
